svg.text: Fig. T1 — 24 triangles on the integer grid
coordinates are grid cells, not units: pitch 256, so one unit is 256 cells; A to D below
curve x = t − t³/3, y = t²; whole-number points at t = 0, 3 and the waist
the chain stops at −1532 in x, four cells short of −1536
grid: unit lines, pale every 1/4 unit
points where the curve hits the lattice
